release_notes: NEW — Tablet Mode: launch a full-screen cooking workspace from any recipe or tap Cook in the recipe collection.
Ingredient and individual instruction checklists remember unfinished progress on the same browser and device.
Substitutions offer ingredient-specific suggestions, explain limitations, and let you record personal replacements without altering saved recipes.
Tablet Mode automatically adapts to portrait and landscape, with large touch controls, progress tracking, Reset checklist, and Finish cooking.
Screen Wake Lock is requested on compatible browsers; older iPads show clear guidance to use Guided Access or the device Auto-Lock setting.
Improved iPad Home Screen application caching and corrected a missing app-logo asset reference.
Repaired API-key scope validation that prevented some server builds from starting or passing tests.
Existing recipes, users, settings, meal plans, shopping lists, and data volumes are preserved. Compatible updates install under Administration → Updates.
